name: elevenlabs
summary: Successfully completed the ElevenLabs quickstart end-to-end. Installed the elevenlabs SDK and python-dotenv, created the example script, and generated a valid MP3 audio file from text using the ElevenLabs Text-to-Speech API. The output file (output.mp3) is 44,765 bytes and has a valid MP3 header (ID3 tag), confirming the text-to-speech generation works correctly.
deviations: The original quickstart uses `play(audio)` to play audio through speakers. Since the sandbox has no audio output device, I created a modified script that saves the generated audio to a file (output.mp3) and verifies it as a valid MP3. This is a necessary adaptation for a headless environment while still demonstrating the core promised outcome: text-to-speech generating an audio file from text.

env_ready.evidence: Defaulting to user installation because normal site-packages is not writeable... Collecting elevenlabs... Downloading elevenlabs-2.65.0-py3-none-any.whl

friction.detail: The quickstart's `play()` function requires `mpv`, which is not installed in the sandbox: `mpv not found`
